name: rvnd-governance
description: The RVND governance layer - skills that teach an AI host to drive the RVND governance MCP server safely: query the lane, propose the action as a typed Loomground envelope, let the server validate it, preview, confirm, apply, and display the verdict, so a request is never shown as a grant. Grounded in the real loomground-language 0.8.0a1 vocabulary; unexpressible meaning stays residual; the skill never writes .lg or computes a verdict; fail-closed. Commercial (RVND) tier of the open-core split.

interface.shortDescription: Drive the RVND governance MCP server safely
interface.longDescription: Five composable skills that teach an AI host to run consequential actions through RVND's governance cycle: query the lane, propose the action, let the server validate it, preview the effect, obtain human confirmation, apply, and display the verdict. The server decides and the host renders, so a request is never shown as a grant. Includes oversight sign-off, tamper-evident audit verification, incident response, and a linter that keeps governance surfaces honest.
defaultPrompt: Run this action through RVND's governance cycle.
Put this to a person for approve/hold/deny.
Verify this receipt against the signed chain.
